motion: water sprays hard from a pipe and a hand reaches for a handle
the red handle rotates and stops perpendicular to the pipe
the flow slows to a trickle and stops
the small light turns red and a tiny alarm icon flashes
the tape winds around the thread in a spiral
the handle lifts off revealing a brass stem
the blue tint seeps into the bowl water
the water rises and stops with a click
the brown water thins and turns clear
the foam tube slides along the pipe and covers it
the small red dial turns slowly
the snake advances with a turning motion
